title: Mixing numbers and strings
hints: Go never converts between numeric types or between numbers and strings implicitly. Each compiler error points at a place where two different types meet.
A conversion looks like float64(x). For turning an int into its decimal text, look at strconv.Itoa or fmt.Sprint.
Convert before dividing, as in float64(sum) / float64(count). Converting the result of sum / count is too late, because integer division has already dropped the fraction.
